title: AlertMatcherGate
description: Whether the alerts of one type have shown enough agreement between the stored condition text and the plan for the plan to decide.

passes.description: True when every requirement below holds.

alerts.description: Alerts of this type that are compiled from selections.

sourcesLackingCoverage.description: Sources that have alerts and fewer than one hundred matched events.

conditionsLackingCoverage.description: Filters and triggers a stored alert uses that have not answered yes twenty times and no twenty times, and are not on the list of conditions production cannot exercise.

alertsNeverCompared.description: Names of alerts all of whose events were counted as not comparable. The reports say nothing about them.
